turns.text: I'd like to practise a hard parent meeting. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. I'll send END MEETING on its own when I want to stop. I'm Owen's English teacher, and Meredith has just walked into my classroom.
Thank you for seeing me. Why was Owen's essay given a zero?
I don't think this is productive.
You asked for this meeting. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen spoken to before it went in?
I'm going to go. I have a class in ten minutes.
You called this meeting, and ten minutes is enough. What did you have when you entered the zero?
Email the principal if you want. I'm done here.
I will, and it will go to the principal tonight. But you're not done until the zero comes off and Owen gets an apology. Sit down.
